levels.title: Check the smallest cases
levels.body_md: Look closely at your if condition and what it allows. Try thinking about very small weights first. What is the smallest weight that can really be split?
levels.question_back: What is the smallest weight that can really be split?

levels.title: Two positive evens need size
levels.body_md: Remember both parts must be positive and even. The smallest positive even number is 2. So the total must be at least 4 to work.

levels.title: Line 6 misses small case
levels.body_md: Your check on `L6` with `w % 2 == 0` is too loose. For input `2`, your code prints `YES` but the expected output is `NO`. This is because 2 cannot be made from two positive evens.

levels.title: Require weight above two
levels.body_md: Both parts must be at least 2, so the sum must be at least 4. Odd numbers can never work, and even numbers work except the smallest one. Your `L6` accepts all evens, so `2` wrongly gives `YES`. Fix it by also requiring `w` to be greater than 2 on the same line. This keeps everything `O(1)` time and memory.
